tara_prod: Heads-up: opened a small Dedicated pool in ap-east-1 (Hong Kong) with L40s and a modest H100 top-up in us-west-1c. This is alpha-capacity for partner migrations.

devin_infra: Specs: ap-east-1: 8 L40s total (soft cap 3/account). us-west-1c: +6 H100s added. To request >soft-cap, submit quota request under 'Dedicated GPU - L40' or 'Dedicated GPU - H100' and include expected tokens/sec and peak seq len. Typical review 48-72h.

jun_sales: Any pilot slots or migration credits for APAC customers?

tara_prod: Pilot slots: 2 partner slots in HK. No blanket credits; AMs can request one-off migration credits via partner-ops for strategic deals. Priority allocation: current Dedicated customers, enterprise SLOs, then pilots.

infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot: ap-east-1 p95 token-latency 55ms, p99 95ms, avg gpu util 32%. us-west-1c p95 44ms, p99 70ms, avg util 59%.

leo_ops: Ops note: L40 images require runtime v2.6+ and driver v1.10+. We're gating mass migrations until staging passes. Scheduled driver tweak Wed 2026-04-08 03:00-04:00 UTC with cross-zone routing; single-zone placements may see brief evictions.

tara_prod: Policy note: for alpha pools, were applying a 7-day early-cancel handling window (no fee) then standard charges apply. Eng-infra to add field early_cancel_window_days to reservation API. @devin_infra please.

devin_infra: Adding early_cancel_window_days integer and reservation_tier enum ["alpha","standard","enterprise"]. Also creating an alert to page if regional spare < 15%.

tara_prod: Action items: (1) eng-infra add API fields and alert @devin_infra, (2) ops publish driver checklist and maintenance notice @leo_ops, (3) sales/AMs to log pilot interest and manage expectations @jun_sales.

jun_sales: On it. Will update partner tracker and DM for approvals.

tara_prod: Will hold external comms until 48h of stable telemetry. Ping here with any immediate issues. :hk:
